findings.title: About pages have no Organization structured data
findings.evidence: 3 of 3 sampled about pages carry no Organization markup, e.g. https://www.airtable.com/about.
findings.mechanism: The Organization type is how a machine learns who is this company, and is it the same entity as the one on Wikipedia/LinkedIn. Without it the page competes on prose alone against sources that state the same facts in a form that needs no interpretation.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD to the about page template.
how: Add a `Organization` JSON-LD block to the about template, populated from the same data the page already renders.
Include the fields that make it answerable: name, url, logo, description, sameAs.
Emit it once per page from the template so new pages inherit it automatically.
platform_specific: Emit the JSON-LD from the route's server component (or `generateMetadata` for metadata fields), so it is present in the server-rendered HTML rather than added on the client.
Build the object from the same data the page fetches, so the markup cannot drift from what is displayed.
suggested_action.verify: Re-run check SDA-005 and confirm it no longer fires.

findings.title: Article structured data is missing required fields
findings.evidence: 1 Article nodes omit datePublished (1x), e.g. on https://www.airtable.com/universe/expVVRw3oKWYCJs2t/jobs.
findings.mechanism: The block is present and parses, so it appears to be working - but without datePublished it cannot answer what does this say, when was it said, and who said it. Consumers that require these fields discard the node entirely, leaving the page in the same position as one with no markup at all.

suggested_action.summary: Populate the required Article fields: datePublished.
how: Add datePublished to the Article block, sourced from the same data the page renders.
Leave a field out entirely rather than emitting an empty string or a placeholder - an empty value is treated as an assertion that the value is empty.
Validate the output against the type's requirements as part of the build.
platform_specific: Emit the JSON-LD from the route's server component (or `generateMetadata` for metadata fields), so it is present in the server-rendered HTML rather than added on the client.
Build the object from the same data the page fetches, so the markup cannot drift from what is displayed.
suggested_action.verify: Re-run check SDA-007 and confirm it no longer fires.
